experience.bio: From an STI2D baccalaureate to engineering school, every step added a layer: the foundations of development and electronics, then the full software lifecycle, and today embedded systems and cybersecurity. Alongside that, my work-study contract at CGI confronts me with the real world: Java applications used daily by the teams of the La Poste group.
